name: customer_id
description: The customer who booked. Joins to customers.customer_id. Every booking belongs to a signed-in customer.

name: package_id
description: The package booked. Joins to packages.package_id, and through it to destinations for the category.

name: booking_date
description: Date the booking was made. Partition column. Compare to plan by the calendar month of this date.

name: travel_start_date
description: First day of travel. Warm escapes booked in late summer typically travel Dec–Apr.

name: channel
description: Last-touch marketing channel credited with the booking: one of paid_search, paid_social, organic, email, direct, affiliate.

name: travelers
description: Number of travelers on the booking.

name: revenue_usd
description: Gross booking value in US dollars (per-person price × travelers, less any promotional discount).

name: status
description: confirmed or cancelled. Only confirmed rows count as bookings.

name: session_id
description: The web session in which the booking was completed, or NULL when it completed in the app or by phone. Joins to web_sessions.session_id.
